event_name: Warboys witch trial executes Samuel family
significance: The Warboys witch trial of 1593 resulted in the execution of John Samuel, Alice Samuel, and their daughter Agnes Samuel for bewitching the five daughters of gentleman Robert Throckmorton; the case attracted considerable attention because the accusers were gentry rather than peasants, prefiguring the social dynamics of elite-sponsored prosecution seen later at Salem.
source_method: Contemporary pamphlet The Most Strange and Admirable Discoverie of the Three Witches of Warboys (1593); analyzed in Macfarlane, Witchcraft in Tudor and Stuart England (1970)
